result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one restaurant card image appears to be stuck loading, and there is a minor inconsistency in favorite icon styling.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a loading spinner overlaid in the center of its image, indicating the image has not finished loading or is stalled.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads correctly, add a proper placeholder, and set a reasonable timeout/fallback so users don't see a persistent spinner.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards — the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circular background while the pizza card uses a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background/contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
